items.title: Bayes-reversed transition kernels for a diffusion
items.strategy: Define the reverse-time kernel from the forward marginal density and transition density, retaining positivity, normalization, Chapman–Kolmogorov and regularity as explicit hypotheses to be checked by the consumer lemma.

items.title: Quadratic variation of a continuous local martingale
items.strategy: Localize to bounded martingales; control left-step martingale sums in L2 by orthogonal increments and Doob’s inequality; pass the exact square-increment identity to the limit and polarize.

items.title: A translated conditional density factorizes after subtraction
items.strategy: Use the determinant-one translation b=d+c to change from the pair (A,B) to (A,B−C), then integrate out C with Tonelli.

items.title: An elliptic local martingale has a Brownian driver
items.strategy: Construct the inverse-diffusion stochastic integral by stopped left-step sums, prove its martingale isometry and covariation from the defining product-martingale identities, then apply the vector Lévy characterization.

items.title: Reversed kernels, generator, and martingale problem
items.strategy: Normalize the Bayes kernels by the forward marginal identity, compose them by forward Chapman–Kolmogorov, differentiate the adjoint transition expression on compactly supported tests, expand the adjoint product rule, and derive the localized reverse martingale problem.

items.title: Anderson's bounded-start reverse-time diffusion theorem
items.strategy: Use the augmented joint Fokker–Planck equation to identify a product Gaussian density, repeat the factorization conditionally to prove reverse-noise increments and their filtration properties, and convert the forward Itô integral to a backward Itô integral with its covariation correction.

items.title: Bayes-reversed Gaussian smoothing kernels
items.strategy: Define the reversed kernel from the explicit Gaussian marginal and transition densities, verify its normalization by the forward marginal identity, and verify reverse Chapman–Kolmogorov by Gaussian transition composition.

items.title: Brownian reconstruction with a predictable elliptic coefficient
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice. Fix a finite horizon $T>0$ and a filtration $(\mathcal F_t)_{0\le t\le T}$. Let $M$ be a continuous adapted $d$-dimensional local martingale with $M_0=0$. Let $\sigma$ be a predictable process of invertible $d\times d$ matrices, with $\|\sigma_t^{-1}\|\le C$ for a finite deterministic constant $C$ and $\int_0^T\|\sigma_t\|_F^2dt<\infty$ almost surely. Suppose
$$[M^i,M^j]_t=\int_0^t(\sigma_s\sigma_s^{\mathsf T})_{ij}ds.$$
Then predictable elementary sums, completed in the localized bracket-energy norm, define $B=\int\sigma^{-1}dM$. It has an adapted continuous version, is standard $d$-dimensional Brownian motion in the given filtration, and
$$M_t=\int_0^t\sigma_s\,dB_s$$
up to indistinguishability. The integral on the right is the localized predictable Brownian integral defined by elementary sums and their $L^2$ completion. This construction on the given finite horizon does not require completeness or right continuity of the filtration, and no continuity of $\sigma$ is assumed.

items.title: Reverse-time SDE for an unbounded-start Markov diffusion
items.strategy: Apply the Bayes kernel and generator lemma, localize coordinate and coordinate-product tests, obtain the reverse local martingale and its covariance, reconstruct Brownian motion with the inverse diffusion matrix, and use the stated martingale-problem well-posedness hypothesis.

items.title: Generator and martingale problem for reversed Gaussian smoothing
items.strategy: Differentiate the explicit Gaussian reverse-kernel expression on compactly supported tests, use the heat equation, expand the adjoint product rule to expose the plus-score sign, and integrate the transition identity to obtain the localized martingale problem.

items.title: Reverse Gaussian smoothing on a truncated time interval
items.strategy: Use the reversed-kernel martingale problem, localize coordinate and product tests, reconstruct Brownian motion by the inverse scalar diffusion and the vector Lévy characterization, apply the published Lipschitz SDE well-posedness interface on [0,T−epsilon], and carry the separate endpoint coupling bound with no score claim at zero.

items.title: State-dependent diffusion needs a divergence correction
items.strategy: Transform Brownian motion by a smooth increasing diffeomorphism with nonconstant derivative, compute its forward score and diffusion-matrix divergence, and show the score-only reverse drift differs from the proven generator formula.

items.title: Bounded-start Brownian reversal under Anderson's hypotheses
items.strategy: Specialize Anderson's theorem to scalar Brownian motion with a bounded smooth initial density, substitute the explicit Gaussian convolution for the marginal density, and retain the joint-density uniqueness premise explicitly.

items.title: A stationary Ornstein–Uhlenbeck diffusion reverses to itself
items.strategy: Insert the stationary Gaussian score into the general reversal formula, compute the reversed drift, and verify the centered normal law remains invariant by the explicit transition mean and variance.
